message: Hello, how are you today?
I worked really hard and finally passed my exam with an excellent score. I am so happy!
I studied so hard for my exam but I failed. I feel like all my effort was wasted.
I am feeling very sad today and I just want someone to listen to me.
I have so much work to do and everything is piling up. I feel completely overwhelmed and I don't know where to start.
What is a good way to help a child develop better communication skills?
I don't know what to do anymore.
Aaj mera dil bohat udaas hai, bas koi meri baat sun le.
Mujhe bohat tension hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kahan se start karun.
Mera exam bohat acha hua, main bohat khush hoon.
Main fail ho gaya aur mujhe bohat bura lag raha hai.
I am bohat stressed today, mujhe samajh nahi aa raha kya karun.
I finally got promoted, Allah ka shukar hai, I am so happy.
I had a difficult day at work.
I think the biggest problem was that I could not finish everything on time.
What are some simple things I can do this evening to relax?
How can I encourage a child to take turns while talking?
I feel like hurting myself and I don't know what to do.
I keep worrying about tomorrow even though there is nothing I can change tonight.
Thank you for listening to me. I really appreciate the support.
